title: Shop
trust: Table looks and coaching only. Nothing here changes the tiles you draw, and clubs are free.
purchaseFailed: The purchase did not go through. Nothing was charged by the app; try again.
pending: Payment received. It can take a minute to reach your account and will appear on its own.
diamondsUse: Diamonds buy table looks. Bonus diamonds are spent first.

coach.body:
Free: the coach at bot tables, the daily puzzle, drills, every lesson, 1 hand review and 1 Puzzle Rush a day, Beginner and Club bots.
Gold: Pro bots and unlimited Puzzle Rush.
Platinum: everything in Gold plus unlimited hand reviews.

unavailable.title: Store unavailable on this build
unavailable.body: Purchases are switched off here, so nothing can be bought or granted. Looks and plans you already own still work.

mock: Development build: a test store. Purchases are instant, free and stay on this device until the next sync with the server.
offline: Offline: showing your balance from the last time the app reached the server.

errors.store_product_missing: This item is not on sale in your store yet.
errors.store_not_signed_in: Connect to the game server first, so the purchase reaches your account.
errors.store_unavailable: The store is not available on this build.

foot: Prices come from your App Store or Google Play region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel them in your store account settings at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Restore purchases brings back plans and looks bought with the same store account.
